name: actuary
description: Audit and evaluate Agent Skills against the agentskills.io spec and authoring best practices. skill-audit produces a layered L1 spec / L2 structural / L3 craft report, and with --tier emits a promotion-readiness verdict gated on a privacy/genericization scan (real IDs, machine paths, key material) — the Gate-1 input the memento:promote flow consumes.

interface.longDescription: Audit Agent Skills (SKILL.md files) against the agentskills.io specification and authoring best practices. Produces a layered report covering spec compliance, structural metrics, and craft-level recommendations. With --tier <local|toolshed|marketplace> it adds a privacy/genericization scan and a promotion-readiness verdict — the Gate-1 input the memento:promote flow consumes. Read-only — never modifies the audited skills.
defaultPrompt: Audit the skills in this plugin.
Check this SKILL.md against agentskills best practices.
Triage every skill in the toolshed marketplace.
